work.summary: Closed the real-device product-ordering defect left by HF2D. The ordering priority itself was correct, but the size parser only recognized explicit units such as 500ml. Real OCR-confirmed names commonly encode capacity as a leading shorthand such as 185ボス..., 240カン..., 270P..., 280P..., 380B..., and 600P..., so they were treated as unknown-size and did not follow the intended size-first order. HF2E recognizes those real printed-name prefixes while preserving explicit-unit parsing, maker grouping, maker-group rank, and equal-size product-number tie-breaking.
implemented: Extended product-sort-hf2d.js size detection to normalize display names and recognize plausible leading 3–4 digit capacity prefixes used by real OCR product names.
Rejected obvious non-capacity leading numbers followed by percent or yen markers.
Preserved maker grouping and maker-group ordering by each maker's youngest natural product number.
Preserved within-maker ordering as smaller detected container size first, then younger/natural product number for equal sizes.
Cache-busted the sorter hotfix to HF2E through ocr-config.js.
Added tests/product-size-prefix-sort-gate.html using the real printed-name patterns 185..., 240カン..., 270P..., 280P..., 380B..., and 600P....
Added the real-prefix gate to the standard GitHub Actions Playwright suite, increasing the browser gate count from seven to eight.
PR Browser regression gates run 35440464231 passed all eight gates, including printed-name leading size, equal-size product-number, and explicit-unit size checks.
